title: King Oliver's band at the Savoy Ballroom lineup
summary: He lists the Oliver band members at the Savoy in New York, with a loop at the end of the trumpet name.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well I'll give you a few of them. You see on piano we had Louis Russell on piano, and banjo, Willie Foster, that's Pop Foster's brother, on banjo. On drums we had Paul Barbaran on drums. And on bass we had a bass player called Buford. Now on trumpet we had King Oliver, Red Island, so far back I can't think of the boy's name. Yeah. That's what I remember. Boy, he just died too, not so long ago.
Great kind of guy. Darnell Harris?
